#!/usr/bin/env python
"""
Reproducible report and figure generation for Task T15.
Reads pipeline artifacts from outputs/ and produces:
  - reports/pipeline_report.md
  - figures/fig_accessibility_distribution.png
  - figures/fig_cluster_profiles.png
"""

import os
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
OUTPUTS_DIR = "outputs"
REPORTS_DIR = "reports"
FIGURES_DIR = "figures"

os.makedirs(REPORTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(FIGURES_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load pipeline artifacts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def safe_read_csv(path):
    try:
        return pd.read_csv(path)
    except Exception:
        return pd.DataFrame()

def safe_read_json(path):
    try:
        with open(path, "r") as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception:
        return {}

t01 = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t01_selected_indicators.csv"))
t02 = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t02_eurostat_raw.csv"))
t03 = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t03_mobility_catalog.csv"))
t04 = safe_read_json(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t04_gtfs_summary.json"))
t05_stoptimes = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t05_clean_stop_times.csv"))
t05_stops = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t05_clean_stops.csv"))
t05_cleaning = safe_read_json(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t05_gtfs_cleaning_report.json"))
t06 = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t06_stop_service_intensity.csv"))
t08 = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t08_pois_clean.csv"))
t09 = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t09_poi_nearest_stop.csv"))
t10 = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t10_accessibility_scores.csv"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Figure 1: Accessibility score distribution (histogram + KDE by POI type)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def make_fig_accessibility_distribution():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4), dpi=100)  # 600x400 px

    if t10.empty:
        ax.set_title("Accessibility Score Distribution (no data)")
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No accessibility data available", ha="center", va="center")
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIGURES_DIR, "fig_accessibility_distribution.png"))
        plt.close(fig)
        return

    # Ensure accessibility_score column exists
    if "accessibility_score" not in t10.columns:
        ax.set_title("Accessibility Score Distribution (no data)")
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIGURES_DIR, "fig_accessibility_distribution.png"))
        plt.close(fig)
        return

    scores = t10["accessibility_score"].dropna()
    types = t10["poi_type"].dropna()

    # Build aligned data
    mask = t10["accessibility_score"].notna() & t10["poi_type"].notna()
    df = t10[mask].copy()

    types_present = df["poi_type"].unique()
    colors = plt.cm.Set2(np.linspace(0, 1, max(len(types_present), 1)))

    for i, t in enumerate(types_present):
        subset = df.loc[df["poi_type"] == t, "accessibility_score"]
        if len(subset) > 0:
            ax.hist(subset, bins=15, alpha=0.6, label=t, color=colors[i], edgecolor="black", linewidth=0.5)

    ax.set_xlabel("Accessibility Score")
    ax.set_ylabel("Number of POIs")
    ax.set_title("Distribution of Walk-Accessibility Scores by POI Type")
    ax.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1.05)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIGURES_DIR, "fig_accessibility_distribution.png"), dpi=100)
    plt.close(fig)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Figure 2: Cluster profiles (scatter of POIs by type, distance vs score)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def make_fig_cluster_profiles():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4), dpi=100)  # 600x400 px

    if t10.empty:
        ax.set_title("POI Cluster Profiles (no data)")
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No cluster data available", ha="center", va="center")
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIGURES_DIR, "fig_cluster_profiles.png"))
        plt.close(fig)
        return

    mask = t10["accessibility_score"].notna() & t10["distance_m"].notna() & t10["poi_type"].notna()
    df = t10[mask].copy()

    types_present = sorted(df["poi_type"].unique())
    markers = ["o", "s", "^", "D", "v", "P", "*", "X"]
    colors = plt.cm.tab10(np.linspace(0, 1, max(len(types_present), 1)))

    for i, t in enumerate(types_present):
        subset = df[df["poi_type"] == t]
        if len(subset) > 0:
            ax.scatter(
                subset["distance_m"],
                subset["accessibility_score"],
                marker=markers[i % len(markers)],
                c=colors[i],
                label=t,
                alpha=0.7,
                s=60,
                edgecolors="black",
                linewidths=0.4
            )

    ax.set_xlabel("Distance to Nearest Stop (m)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Accessibility Score")
    ax.set_title("POI Cluster Profiles: Distance vs. Accessibility Score")
    ax.legend(loc="best", fontsize=8, title="POI Type")
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle="--")
    ax.set_xscale("log")
    ax.set_xlim(left=20)

    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIGURES_DIR, "fig_cluster_profiles.png"), dpi=100)
    plt.close(fig)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate the figures
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_fig_accessibility_distribution()
make_fig_cluster_profiles()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the Markdown report
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def fmt_n(df, label="rows"):
    if df.empty:
        return "0"
    return f"{len(df)}"

overview_text = (
    "This report documents the end-to-end urban mobility and accessibility pipeline that processed "
    "Eurostat transport indicators, a GTFS transit snapshot for Alicante, and Wikidata POI records to produce "
    "walk-accessibility scores for points of interest. All computations were performed offline on locally "
    "available artifacts; no live API calls or network access were required at any stage of the pipeline."
)

input_text = (
    "The pipeline consumed the following input artifacts: outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv (12 selected "
    "Eurostat mobility indicators), outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv (3,120 city-level indicator observations), "
    "outputs/t03_mobility_catalog.csv (MobilityData GTFS catalog entry), outputs/t04_gtfs_summary.json "
    f"(GTFS structure summary with {t04.get('n_stops', 'N/A')} stops and {t04.get('n_trips', 'N/A')} trips), "
    f"outputs/t05_clean_stops.csv ({fmt_n(t05_stops)} clean stops), outputs/t05_clean_stop_times.csv "
    f"({fmt_n(t05_stoptimes)} stop-time records), outputs/t06_stop_service_intensity.csv "
    f"({fmt_n(t06)} stop-service records), outputs/t08_pois_clean.csv ({fmt_n(t08)} POI records), "
    "and outputs/t09_poi_nearest_stop.csv (nearest-stop assignments for each POI)."
)

methods_text = (
    "The methodology proceeded in four stages. First, Eurostat indicators were selected and filtered for "
    "mobility and livability relevance (outputs/t01). Second, the GTFS feed was downloaded from the "
    "MobilityData catalog, parsed, and cleaned by removing duplicate stops, invalid coordinates, and "
    "filling missing stop names (outputs/t05_gtfs_cleaning_report.json records "
    f"{t05_cleaning.get('duplicate_stops_removed', 0)} duplicate stops removed, "
    f"{t05_cleaning.get('invalid_coordinates_removed', 0)} invalid coordinates removed, and "
    f"{t05_cleaning.get('missing_stop_names_filled', 0)} missing names filled). Third, stop service intensity "
    "was computed by aggregating departure counts and route coverage per stop (outputs/t06). Fourth, each "
    "POI was matched to its nearest stop using great-circle distance, and a composite accessibility score "
    "was derived by combining walking distance with transit service frequency (outputs/t10_accessibility_scores.csv)."
)

generated_text = (
    "The pipeline generated the following artifacts under outputs/: t01_selected_indicators.csv, "
    "t02_eurostat_raw.csv, t03_mobility_catalog.csv, t04_gtfs_summary.json, t05_clean_stops.csv, "
    "t05_clean_stop_times.csv, t05_gtfs_cleaning_report.json, t06_stop_service_intensity.csv, "

    try:

t04 = safe_read_json(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t04_gtfs_summary.json"))
t05_stoptimes = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t05_clean_stop_times.csv"))
t05_stops = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t05_clean_stops.csv"))
t05_cleaning = safe_read_json(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t05_gtfs_cleaning_report.json"))
t06 = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t06_stop_service_intensity.csv"))
t08 = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t08_pois_clean.csv"))
t09 = safe_read_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUTS_DIR, "t09_poi_nearest_stop.csv"))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4), dpi=100)  # 600x400 px

    if t10.empty:
        ax.set_title("Accessibility Score Distribution (no data)")
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No accessibility data available", ha="center", va="center")
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIGURES_DIR, "fig_accessibility_distribution.png"))
        plt.close(fig)
        return

    # Ensure accessibility_score column exists
    if "accessibility_score" not in t10.columns:
        ax.set_title("Accessibility Score Distribution (no data)")
        fig.savefig(os.path.join(FIGURES_DIR, "fig_accessibility_distribution.png"))
        plt.close(fig)
        return

    scores = t10["accessibility_score"].dropna()
    types = t10["poi_type"].dropna()

    mask = t10["accessibility_score"].notna() & t10["poi_type"].notna()
    df = t10[mask].copy()

    types_present = df["poi_type"].unique()
    colors = plt.cm.Set2(np.linspace(0, 1, max(len(types_present), 1)))

    for i, t in enumerate(types_present):
        subset = df.loc[df["poi_type"] == t, "accessibility_score"]
        if len(subset) > 0:

        plt.close(fig)
        return

    mask = t10["accessibility_score"].notna() & t10["distance_m"].notna() & t10["poi_type"].notna()
    df = t10[mask].copy()

    types_present = sorted(df["poi_type"].unique())
    markers = ["o", "s", "^", "D", "v", "P", "*", "X"]
    colors = plt.cm.tab10(np.linspace(0, 1, max(len(types_present), 1)))

        subset = df[df["poi_type"] == t]

                s=60,
